name: o-json: choose and open a file

actions.label: Keep the current document
actions.caption: esc leaves the picker's search line for normal mode and q closes it, keeping the open document. Use it when you decide against switching files.

actions.label: Choose the previous file
actions.caption: ctrl+j moves down once; ctrl+k moves back up. Use it to correct a choice without closing the picker.

actions.label: Choose the next file
actions.caption: ctrl+j moves down the file choices. Check the highlighted name before you open it.

actions.label: Show recent files
actions.caption: alt+s steps from browsing folders to the recent files (S does in the picker's normal mode). Use it to reopen a document without remembering its path.

actions.label: Browse inside a folder
actions.caption: Type jobs, then ctrl+l opens that folder. Browse its JSON files before choosing which job to inspect.

actions.label: Open the highlighted file
actions.caption: Type nested, then alt+enter picks that JSON file. The picker closes and o-json shows its structure.

actions.label: Browse the parent folder
actions.caption: Type jobs and press ctrl+l to enter it; alt+up returns to the sample folder. Use it to recover your place while browsing.

actions.label: Match a partial filename
actions.caption: Among the recent files (alt+s), type smpl, then shift+tab chooses substring matching and tab returns to fuzzy. Find sample.json even when you remember only some letters.

actions.label: Match with a different search style
actions.caption: Among the recent files (alt+s), type sample, then shift+tab cycles filename matching backward. Choose the style that fits the text you remember.

notes.note: e opens the file picker; alt+s steps to our recent sample files.
Reset point: every action begins here again; earlier actions never change this starting state.
